en.text:
Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 Precision Hits  within 2 seconds of each <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine and grants 1 stack of 'Fate of All Fools'. Maximum of 15 stacks. 

Fate of All Fools grants 100% increased damage to Firefly explosions while active.

Non-precision Direct Hits consume one stack of Fate of All Fools and make the shot deal precision damage.
